Quick Safety Tips

Do Not Engage

Don't respond to bullying messages. Responses often escalate the situation.

Screenshot Everything

Take screenshots of harassment before it's deleted. This is crucial evidence.

Adjust Privacy Settings

Make your profiles private and control who can contact you and see your content.

Report & Block

Use platform reporting tools and block users. Platform teams take these reports seriously.

Talk to Someone

Reach out to a trusted friend, family member, or counselor. You're not alone.

Keep Records

Document dates, times, and details of incidents in a safe place for future reference.

Need Immediate Help?

Our 24/7 chatbot support team is ready to help you report incidents and provide guidance.
